acquisition method: Q-Exactive HF was used in data dependent mode.
cleavage agent: Proteins on the filters are then digested twice at 30oc with trypsin (2 x 1μg)

fractionation method: peptides fractionated using High pH RP HPLC
instrument: Analysis of peptides was performed using a Q-Exactive-HF (Thermo Scientific) mass spectrometer
labeling: We performed a complex 8-plex TMT LC-MS/MS analysis.
reduction reagent: Each sample was then reduced with 100 mM DTT
